subject: Request: approval to open 2 security hires (GRC + SecEng) and comp bands
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: approval to open 2 security hires (GRC + SecEng) and comp bands

Hi team,

Following our Q3 planning, I'm requesting approval to move forward with two hires on the security org: a Senior GRC Manager (IC lead for policy & audits) and a Security Engineer (infra-focused, backend/service posture). These are bucketed as mission-critical for upcoming enterprise renewals and SOC 2 prep.

Summary: 
- Roles: Senior GRC Manager (req GH-8342), Security Engineer (req GH-8343)
- Headcount: +2 FTEs (additional to plan; need exception to hiring freeze)
- Proposed comp bands: see attached comp_bands_security_Q3_2026.xlsx (market 75-90th pctile for SF/remote US)
- Draft offer for GRC manager attached (offer_Senior-GRC-Manager_draft.pdf)

Ask: please confirm headcount & comp-band approval and sign off for HR to extend offer to Miguel Santos (recruiter recommended; profile attached in Greenhouse). If we can get approvals this week, PearlSearch can get the offer to the candidate and start DocuSign.

Notes: 
- Budget: we believe both roles fit in the security org incrementality with small reallocation from contractor budget; see org_chart_security_team.png.
- Timing: candidate expects an offer by 7/9 to avoid counteroffers.

Attaching: offer draft, comp bands, org chart.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approval to open 2 security hires (GRC + SecEng) and comp bands

Vanessa —

Thanks for the packet and the urgency callout. I support opening both reqs and agree the roles are high priority given the SOC 2 timeline and enterprise renewal coverage. Quick notes: 
- Senior GRC Manager: OK at the proposed band, but please tighten the performance bonus target language in the offer to avoid misaligned expectations (suggest 10% target).
- Security Engineer: please include clear on-call expectations (rotation + stipend) in the JD / offer.

Assuming HR confirms budget reallocation from contractors, I give my approval to proceed with offers to the selected candidates.

Marissa
VP, Governance & Risk
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approval to open 2 security hires (GRC + SecEng) and comp bands

Team —

Thanks for surfacing. A few budget questions before I can greenlight headcount exception: 
1) Confirm total FY26 incremental cost for both hires (fully loaded: salary + taxes + benefits + equity). Provide a single-line number.
2) Which contractor roles are we pausing / reducing to fund these — list by cost center and monthly spend.
3) If we approve, is there a hiring timeline risk that pushes compensation into Q4? We need to avoid material Q4 overrun.

If you can get me the incremental cost and the contractor reallocation by EOD Tuesday I'll sign off.

-Rishi
CFO
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approval to open 2 security hires (GRC + SecEng) and comp bands

Rishi —

See the quick breakdown below (fully loaded estimates). I've pulled from comp_bands_security_Q3_2026.xlsx and payroll models: 
- Senior GRC Manager: Total first-year cost = $285,000 (base $200,000, equity budget ~ $60,000, benefits/taxes ~ $25,000).
- Security Engineer: Total first-year cost = $215,000 (base $145,000, equity ~$50,000, benefits/taxes ~$20,000).
- Incremental FY26 hit (prorated hiring in July): ~$245,000 total incremental run-rate for the remainder of FY26.

Contractor reallocation suggestion: pause two non-critical infra contractors (ENG-C-112, ENG-C-137) starting 7/15. Combined monthly savings ~ $45k; projected annual savings covers both hires. Finance and Talent will track the reallocation in the HR ledger.

Timing: if we approve now HR can issue offers this week; start dates target mid-August which keeps Q4 exposure minimal.

Mina — please prepare the DocuSign offer and confirm Greenhouse reqs GH-8342 / GH-8343 are live.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of People Ops
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approval to open 2 security hires (GRC + SecEng) and comp bands

All —

Thanks for the numbers and sign-offs. Per Lauren's note, I have: 
- Created GH reqs: GH-8342 (Senior GRC Manager) and GH-8343 (Security Engineer).
- Prepared offer packet for Miguel Santos (Senior GRC Manager); draft attached.
- Updated offer to include 10% performance target (Marissa) and on-call stipend + rotation note (Marissa) for SecEng.
- Marked contractors ENG-C-112 and ENG-C-137 for pause effective 7/15 and submitted cost-reallocation to Finance.

Next steps:
1) Rishi — please reply with ok to headcount exception so I can send the DocuSign link to the candidate.
2) Vanessa/Marissa — confirm final sign-off on the attached PDF.

If Rishi replies OK I will send DocuSign and cc: vanessa, marissa. Candidate expects answer before 7/10.

Mina Haddad
Senior Talent Partner
mina_haddad@redwood.com

On Wed, Jul 8, 2026 at 09:20 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> OK — approve headcount exception and contractor reallocation as proposed.
> Please proceed.
> 
> -Rishi
